audit_status_report

Check a status update before it goes to a person: flags completion claims with no evidence,
hedged results, and missing blockers (paid, metered; pairs with the free honest-status skill).

missing sections, word limits,

tools.name: audit_compose
tools.description:
Review a docker-compose file for security and reliability (paid, metered): unpinned images,
exposed databases/admin panels, plaintext secrets, Docker socket mounts, privileged containers,
missing volumes, restart policies and health checks. Send the whole file as text.

tools.name: audit_backup_plan
tools.description:
Check a backup plan against 3-2-1 with tested restores (paid, metered).

datasets: [{name, copies: [{type: original|backup|snapshot|raid|sync, location, medium,
offsite: bool, encrypted: bool, last_restore_test: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}]}]. Count the original as a copy.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "audit_compose" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
